title: Consent and analytics per tenant
description:
Outcome: What must be true: the consent banner, its words and its region policy come from the tenant's SiteConfig; analytics use the tenant's own measurement id; no Anthus analytics run on a tenant's site unless disclosed (owner decision 8 in the design note). The region-aware consent behaviour in core applies to every tenant by default.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): src/papyrus_content/projection/standard (consent chrome, chrome.consent_mode), SiteConfig analytics fields (PPY-1252ce), docs/region-aware-consent.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features/tenant-consent.feature):
Scenario: A tenant's site loads only its own analytics after consent
    Given "alpha" set its own measurement id
    When a reader in a consent region accepts
    Then only alpha's measurement id is loaded

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-1252ce. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Browser test of the banner per region.
Rollout: Shared stack.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a tenant without an analytics id still loads a script. Mitigation: no id means no script.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
